main_text.p: Ezech. 28. 11. ex forma Hebr. pro מְשֻׂכְּלָל. Fœminin. מְשֻׂכְּלָא, cap. 27. 2.
שָׁכַן Heb. Habitavit. Hinc Syr. Fut. יִשְׁכַּן Ut avis habitet, nidificet, niduletur, Mar. 4. 32.
Pahel Ch. רַשְׁכֵּן Qui fecit habitare, Cantic. 3. 10.
שָׁכְנָא Ch. Habitans, habitator, vicinus, Prov. 27. 10.
שְׁכוּנָא Chal. Tabernaculum, tentorium. Plur. masc. שְׁכוּנִין Jerem. 3. 2. & 9. 26. Jud. 8. 11. Fœm. שְׁכוּנָן Jobi 15. 28. Convenit Græc. σκηνή.
שְׁכִינְתָּא Ch. Habitatio, divinitas, gloria, majestas divina inter homines habitans.
מִשְׁכְּנָא, מִשְׁכַּן Chal. & Syr. Habitatio, habitaculum, tabernaculum. Plur. מִשְׁכְּנִין Tabernacula.
מִשְׁכּוּנְתָּא, מִשְׁכּוּנָא Ch. Arrha, Pignus, eò quòd habitat aut manet apud commodantem donec redimatur. Hinc verbum quadratum, littera servili in radicalem conversa,
מַשְׁכֵּן Pahel Ch. Pignerari, pro pignore, in pignus accipere, mutuare sub pignore, Exod. 22. 25. in Jonath. Deut. 15. 6. Ithpahel אִתְמַשְׁכַּן Mutuari, dato pignore mutuo accipere, Ibid. in Jon.
שְׁכַר שְׁכָרָא Ch. בְּכַר Syr. Inebriativum, potus inebrians, Sicera, σικέρα, Prov. 30 1. Luc. 1. 15. Heb. שָׁכַר.
סַכְּרָא Syr. Fœdum, turpe, 1. ad Cor. 11. 6. Gr. αἰσχρόν.
שְׂכַר שְׂכָרָא Ch. Merces, præmiu, וּשְׂכַר פְּקוּדוֹי Et merces mandatorum ipsius, Cant. 2. 3. Heb. שָׂכָר.
שְׁלִיב שְׁלִיבָא Ch. Gradus, scalæ, prominentiæ gradatæ, 1. Reg. 7. 28. מִשְׁלַבִּין

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vocalised Aramaic forms in the lower entries are only partly legible and may contain errors. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
